scripted_turns: make a FigJam process of how a Fernhouse damaged-item refund moves between the customer, CS and the warehouse, on a new board in our Fernhouse Product plan, and highlight the handoff to the warehouse. From the support runbook: the customer reports damage with a photo through the help form. A CS agent checks the photo, approves clear damage on the spot and asks for a second photo when it is unclear. An approved claim goes to the warehouse queue, where an operator books a courier pickup, inspects the item on arrival and releases the refund. Every decision is logged in the claims table. Refunds under 20 euros skip the pickup, a pilot that is not yet live.
